INTERNAL NOTES

"Elena was thrilled with the orchard view in June — she'd happened to find a wedding day with fennel from the field. Worth recreating."

— Camille, 12 May 2024

On the first reply, a guest's enquiry is a doorway. Answer it within the hour. In her own case it is the first lesson laid out.
On the small ask, a bottle of the Barolo, a hike out, a recommendation to dinner — these are the bread and butter of a reply.
On the silence afterward, Not every message warrants a reply. Often, a thanks and a fold of the linen at midnight will suffice for our second.
